findings.message: Object.hasOwn is fine for the own-key check on modern Node, but its availability is a compatibility risk: `Object.hasOwn` was only added in ES2022 (Node 16.9+). If this code runs on older runtimes (e.g., Node 14/16.0–16.8 or other environments), `Object.hasOwn` is undefined and calling it throws a TypeError, breaking cache lookups entirely — a regression from the previous `hasOwnProperty.call` form. Ensure the supported runtime baseline includes `Object.hasOwn`, or guard/shim it.
